256672|a1748e17.name: Kurvelk Shadowhoof
256672|a1748e17.text:
Ehh? You look a little too new to be doing business with me.

Come back once you're a bit more familiar with how they do things around here. Trust me.

2706|368f0fed.name: Tor'gan
2706|368f0fed.text: Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.

2733|10e876c3.name: Apothecary Jorell
2733|10e876c3.text:
Are you here to make a contribution to research? 

Do you have any limbs you're willing to part with?

1067-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
1067-progress.text: You have returned, $N.  Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?
1067-progress.title: Return to Thunder Bluff

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-progress.text: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
1196-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

413-progress.name: Mountaineer Barleybrew
413-progress.text:
Hello, $C!  And what business takes you all the way out here?

Something exciting, I hope.  I haven't been in a good fight in days, and this barrel of ale is almost dry...
413-progress.title: Shimmer Stout

6387-progress.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
6387-progress.text: Have you had your fill of Thelsamar so soon?  Are you ready to leave for another city?
6387-progress.title: Honor Students

6388-progress.name: Gryth Thurden
6388-progress.text: You look like you have somewhere to go.  Need one of my gryphons?
6388-progress.title: Gryth Thurden

6391-progress.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
6391-progress.text: What can I do for you, sir?
6391-progress.title: Ride to Ironforge

6392-progress.name: Brock Stoneseeker
6392-progress.text: Ah, $N.  Have you returned from Ironforge?
6392-progress.title: Return to Brock

6543-progress.name: Kadrak
6543-progress.text: Hurry, $N. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.
6543-progress.title: The Warsong Reports

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

94244-accept.name: Unknown
94244-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Dark Leather Shoulders, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94244-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders

94244-complete.name: Narkk
94244-complete.text:
Thar be me shoulderpads, at last!

Ever had one of these squakers perch on your shoulder? Bet ye' haven't! Their claws, they hurt!

Now they got a place to rest all day, and you have a heavier coinpurse!

<Narkk eyes said coinpurse.>

For now!
94244-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders

94244-progress.name: Narkk
94244-progress.text: Yarr, what business do ye' have with ol' Narkk?
94244-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Dark Leather Shoulders

94449-complete.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94449-complete.text: Hmm... that elder sent ye, eh? Well, a $c's word is solid, so I'll not argue. That means ye're ready for the next sapta. The sapta of fire. I see it in yer eyes already -- the burnin', the hunger. Ye've tasted power, and now ye want more. But mind yerself, $N. Remember what the stone taught ye. Fire's easy to wield, but harder to master. Know when to hold back.
94449-complete.title: Call of Fire

94465-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94465-progress.text:
Greetin's, $N. Ye've made it to the Shrine o' the Dormant Flame, eh? Not many do. Only those well-versed in the $c's path can grasp the secrets this place holds. 

Shame ye came all this way just to be turned back--the climb's no stroll through Dun Morogh. But I'm the shrine's keeper, and I won't be lettin' just any foot trod about.
94465-progress.title: Call of Fire

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

97539-accept.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-accept.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539-accept.title: Silky Sutures

98887-accept.name: Horde Warbringer
98887-accept.text:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. 

Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887-accept.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
